ideas.title: The Impact of the Minnesota Fraud Scandal on the 2026 Elections
ideas.description: This story would investigate how the ongoing fraud scandal in Minnesota could impact the 2026 elections, particularly in terms of voter sentiment and candidate standings.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would focus on the intersection of politics and fraud, examining how the scandal could influence the election outcome.
questions: How will the fraud scandal affect voter turnout?
Which candidates are most vulnerable to the scandal?
ideas.insight: The Minnesota fraud scandal has significant implications for the 2026 elections, and understanding its impact is crucial to understanding the political landscape.
